description:
Non-bash tool cards keep their error details without header status marks. The conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} ran one change_dir tool call to a directory that does not exist. "The card" is the first element matching .tool[data-testid="tool-call-completed"]; "the header" is the card's .tool-header. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait for the card to be visible (allow 30s).
2. The header contains no .tool-status-icon element (count 0), and the header's text contains neither "✓" nor "✗".
3. Click the header.
4. The card's .tool-details text contains "Result (Error):".
5. The card's .tool-details text contains "directory does not exist".
